# boomi_data_integration_logicode_file (Resource)

A logicode (Python) script file for use in logic data flow logicode steps. The API is create+read only — DELETE and PUT both return 405. Any change to filename or content forces a new resource (new file_id). On destroy, TF removes the resource from state only; the file itself is retained by the platform.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String, Sensitive) Python script content. Stored in state; never read back from the API. Changing it forces a new file.
- `filename` (String) Display name for the script file (e.g. "my_script.py"). Changing it forces a new file.

### Optional

- `environment_id` (String) Environment this file belongs to. Falls back to the provider-level environment_id. Changing it forces a new file.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The file_id assigned by the API. Reference this in data_flow properties_json.
